principle: Intelligence proposes; verification promotes; explicit authority executes

primitives.description: Compose capabilities across domains into one candidate instead of treating domains as isolated assistants.
Every candidate carries explicit proof obligations, evidence and verification state.
Generate alternate architectures and compare them by executable evidence rather than chat preference.
Branch hypotheses and invalidate failed knowledge without silently rewriting history.
Verified inventions become reusable capabilities that can participate in later synthesis.
Operations have explicit phases, event history, replay and recovery hooks.
The workspace is generated from the customer's objective, domain mix, constraints and output type.
GitHub repositories are treated as versioned engineering evidence and lineage sources.
A capability records evidence and invariants required to re-use it, rather than exposing only a text answer.
